title: Windshield Assembly — Installation

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of one windshield assembly with the applicable sealant standard, the bead profile, the cure time before pressurisation and the heating functional check that releases the aircraft.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install one windshield assembly and to return the flight compartment window to service, including the sealing standard that applies to the frame configuration fitted.
sections.job_setup_note: Read the sealant standard from the aircraft configuration before you start. Post modification aircraft use the higher temperature sealant with the defined bead profile and a longer cure; using the delivered sealant on a drained bracket gives a bead that will not fill the drain land correctly. Condition the cartridges to workshop temperature and check the shelf life. Plan the full cure time into the aircraft release, not into the shift.
sections.procedure: 1. Do a visual inspection of the frame land and confirm it is clean, dry and free of marks. 2. Where the drained corner bracket is fitted, confirm the drain path is clear with the gauge. 3. Apply the sealant bead to the frame land using the profile template for the standard fitted. 4. CAUTION: DO NOT EXCEED THE SEALANT WORKING LIFE PRINTED ON THE CARTRIDGE. A BEAD APPLIED AFTER THE WORKING LIFE WILL NOT WET THE FRAME LAND. 5. Lift the pane into the aperture with the vacuum frame and two people and seat it squarely. 6. Install the retaining fasteners hand tight in the sequence shown, then torque in two passes. 7. Remove the extruded sealant and form the fillet with the tool. 8. Connect the heating film connections and remove the tags. 9. WARNING: DO NOT PRESSURISE THE AIRCRAFT BEFORE THE FULL CURE TIME HAS PASSED. AN UNCURED BEAD CAN BE DISPLACED BY THE PRESSURE DIFFERENTIAL. 10. Wait the full cure time stated for the sealant standard. 11. Close the heating circuit breakers and do the window heating functional check. 12. Do the cabin pressurisation leak check at the aperture. 13. Refit the interior trim panel.
sections.close_out: Remove the warning notices and the temporary protection. Record the installation, the pane part number and serial number, the sealant standard and batch, the cure start time and the heating check result in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; sealant standard depends on the frame configuration, see MOD-168212

safety_precautions: Do not pressurise the aircraft before the full cure time has passed.
Condition the sealant cartridges and check the shelf life before use.
